hook_line: SOLD-OUT EDEN PARK CROWD TO BREAK NEW ZEALAND BILATERAL RECORD FOR INDIA T20I

hook_stat.sub: Fans expected at Eden Park on Friday

diaspora_bullets: The sell-out underlines the commercial weight India now carry as a touring side
The fixture is the fourth sell-out of the five-match T20I series
news_summary: New Zealand Cricket has confirmed a complete sell-out for Friday's fourth T20 International against India at Eden Park, where a crowd of nearly 40,000 will set a new bilateral series attendance record.
payoff: India have already won the series, leading 3-0 — Friday's match cannot change the series result.
